component.name: rippl
component.summary: A small, fast, quiet web browser

description.p: rippl is a web browser for Linux on WebKit that stays small: tabs you aren't looking at sleep and give their memory back, ads and trackers are blocked before a page loads, and nothing you do is sent anywhere you didn't send it.

ul.li: Tabs down the side, in spaces with their own sign-ins, pins and folders, split view
Ad and tracker blocking with EasyList and uBlock Origin's lists, YouTube included
Passwords in your system keyring, history and bookmarks on this computer only
Reading mode, peek at links, Ctrl+Tab switcher, your own shortcuts
Optional: an AI assistant and translation with a model running on this computer
